info.background_text:
The girl who manifests fairy tales.
Rescued from a pirate ship by Amir of the Terrascion SID, Adelheid has the ability to manifest fairy tales. She can create and attack with beings from fairy tales using light. She often uses fairy tale metaphors and descriptions in her conversations.
